title: independent method audit (sensitivity, not calibration)

conventions.fixed_conditions: SMD acetonitrile, 298.15 K, 1 mol/L solution standard state
conventions.method_choice_rule: QC availability, numerical stability, gas-phase anchor comparability, rank sensitivity, measured cost
conventions.forbidden_rule: do not pick the method that produces more flips
conventions.diffuse_rule: reduction settings must include diffuse functions; boundness cannot be inferred from a converged finite basis
conventions.audit_nature: sensitivity assessment, NOT a calibrated probability error

method_settings.note: range-separated hybrid; triple-zeta; no diffuse functions
adds diffuse functions; required for reduction states

existing_reusable_jobs.caveat: no diffuse functions; no thermal correction
reduction axis excluded by the unbound_anion rule
single representative motif; identity stratification applies

stop_conditions: method spread comparable to the target gap -> freeze as unresolved
pervasive identity/QC problems across candidate settings -> narrow the comparable question first

checks.description: 方法矩阵 = 8 分子 x 4 状态 x 4 设定 = 128
存在含弥散函数的设定可用于还原态
至少两个泛函（生产候选 + 审计对照）
既有可复用作业只到电子能层
方法选择规则不按翻转数量
checks.detail: 冻结规则：QC 可用率 / 数值稳定性 / 气相 anchor 可比 / 固定介质内 rank sensitivity / 实测成本
